publication_redactions.policy: Local paths and process/timestamp identifiers only; numeric diagnostics and failed statuses preserved.

replay.dynamics_limitation: Original isolated action replay metrics are retained but not a pass claim. PandaGripper.current_action is integrated hidden controller state absent from flattened MuJoCo states; resetting each sample does not restore it.
replay.normalization: Original checkpoint preprocessor; no new gripper or controller scaling
replay.pass_requirements: All 50 demos have exact robot qpos/state mapping and 20Hz row adjacency; recorded-state plus native post-mj_step cache reconstruction passes unchanged EEF/gripper/camera thresholds; training arrays are never altered
replay.policy_image_operation: source raw RGB rotated 180 degrees once, as current policy_observation
